about: Extend the visa of a companion of a GCC citizen by 30 days.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Extension of entry permit for companions of GCC citizens. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Passport valid for at least 6 months
documents: Entry card of the companion of the GCC citizen
Proof of identity of the GCC citizen
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
